description: Delete multiple emails at once with chunking and auto-reconnection. Processes deletions in batches to prevent connection timeouts.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

chunkSize.description: Number of emails to delete per batch (default: 50)

uids.description: Array of email UIDs to delete

name: imap_bulk_delete
